state.description: Original schema-1 IoState, strictly decoded and validated by protocol.rs/recovery.rs; carried unchanged.

legacyCheckpoint.description: Opaque legacy member responsibility. The original Rust schema is authoritative; hosts must preserve every field.

privateMemberV4.$comment: Nested statuses/items/actions use existing Rust StatusView, ItemAmount, PlayerSkillView and PlayerActionView contracts.

boss_phase.$comment: Runtime decoders enforce phase_index <= phase_count, epoch == entity.generation, and monotonic phases per entity generation.

replicationConfig.$comment: Rust validates relative bounds TTL>=ack, period<=TTL and grace>=2*ack.

items.$comment: Mechanism parameters are validated by the SDK skill loader; this fragment validates the library container and identity.
